notes.title: Card Shark Version 1.2 and Fan Art!
notes.content:
We’ve released a new patch with more bug fixes! Scroll to the bottom to read all the new changes. I also wanted to show you some of the amazing fan art we’ve received from around the world!

[h2]Card Shark Fan Art[/h2]

[b]You can join our community of cheaters on [url=discord.gg/nerial]Discord[/url] and [url=twitter.com/nerial]Twitter[/url] to see more of these tricks![/b]

[url=https://twitter.com/Aluhnim][b]@aluhnim[/b][/url] on Twitter made this outstanding fake animation cel! 
[url=https://twitter.com/Aluhnim/status/1532145344468791297][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38555693/eda37c4ced3f093a2f4e84442d2587b6298218ae.jpg[/img][/url]

One of our biggest fans, [url=https://twitter.com/zbxm1004][b]@zbxm1004[/b][/url] is an awesome source of art and memes. 

[url=https://twitter.com/zbxm1004/status/1536630525922017281][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38555693/86a02d70d20a7f98f15375a730fabc9fd97ac49e.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/zbxm1004/status/1533303802107142145][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38555693/370bbc7cb3317c2d582dbba24721dde5cdada521.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/zbxm1004/status/1531571361315176448][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38555693/c37b1f94e1a540004c508ea22492c03f865214d2.jpg[/img][/url]

And who else wants a Card Shark manga by [url=https://twitter.com/terutiru][b]@terutiru[/b][/url]? 
[url=https://twitter.com/terutiru/status/1536980302681489408][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38555693/c0b7382e950ff5a283bf8434706d956e133e8f2e.jpg[/img][/url]

This is a brilliant reference to [strike]Michaelangelo[/strike] Caravaggio’s “The Cardsharps” by [url=https://twitter.com/laowuxi11]@laowuxi11[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/laowuxi11/status/1535657746913034240][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38555693/c4dc93dbf2cbd8d91047009df61b46b46ecd49b9.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]First Cascarot Camp, Magician’s Trick:[/b] Corrected incorrect arm skins.
[*] [b]First Hospice Carriage:[/b] Fixed incorrect dialogue playing after shuffle explanation.
[*] [b]First Hospice: [/b]Fixed Aramitz going to negative money.
[*] [b]Chateau Carriage:[/b] Fixed table arrangement not matching tutorial.
[*] [b]Second Cafe Carriage:[/b] Removed Reset button during technique explanation.
[*] [b]Cour des Miracles:[/b] Added reminder of requested cards when failing Sticky Hand or Full Harvest.
[*] [b]Cour des Miracles:[/b] Prevented softlock when listening to Erdnase Shuffle explanation several times in a row.
[*] [b]Second Bathing Establishment Carriage:[/b] Fixed explanation permitting mistake in Sticky Hand.
[*] [b]Second Bathing Establishment:[/b] Fixed a potential softlock when failing to steal a card in Sticky Hand.
[*] [b]Freeplay, Strategy 10 - The Shiner:[/b] Fixed opponent hand sometimes having no high card.
[*] [b]Epilogue:[/b] Fixed softlock while pouring wine slowly.
[*] [b]UI:[/b] Fixed misplaced money UI after caught dialogues.
[*] [b]Reminder:[/b] The controls for False Riffle Shuffle were outdated.
[*] [b]Art:[/b] Minor visual improvements to Nicolai’s already stupendous art.
[/list]

notes.title: Card Shark Version 1.1
notes.content:
[h3]Thank you for playing Card Shark.
[/h3]
We tried to make a game that was unlike any other but to do that, tough design decisions had to be made. While it isn't a game for everyone, we are so glad that many of you have enjoyed the experience for what it is. The tension and stakes, the learning and progression, the themes and presentation. These are just a few of the elements we wanted to convey and our players understand that.

If you'd like to see how this game was made, you can watch the new mini-documentary that goes Behind the Schemes.

[previewyoutube=doeBqMtE7AU;full][/previewyoutube]
We are also very grateful that you've stayed patient despite the bugs!

Since launching last week, we've been hard at work to address the issues you reported here in the Steam forums, in our Discord server and on social media. We still have more improvements to make, but we wanted to get these ones to you ASAP.

Version 1.1 includes these fixes and changes:

[list]
[*] [b]Gambling House:[/b] Fixed softlock when not pouring enough wine.
[*] [b]Salon:[/b] Fixed looping back to Limbo after failures against the Comte.
[*] [b]First Salon Carriage:[/b] Fixed incorrect dialogue for pincer shuffle variations.
[*] [b]Chateau:[/b] Fixed soft lock occurring mid deal if no card is stolen in Sticky Hand.
[*] [b]Cour des Miracles:[/b] Intro cut-scene now plays correctly when loading a save game.
[*] [b]Versaille:[/b] Fixed softlock in final round.
[*] [b]Theatre:[/b] Prevented Comte from sitting in first seat in strategy 16.
[*] [b]Second Deal:[/b] Fixed issues with input being remembered during dialogue.
[*] [b]Pincer Shuffle:[/b] Explanations can no longer get stuck when single-shuffling / injogging in final shuffle pass.
[*] [b]Full Harvest:[/b] Fixed mouse inputs being queued.
[*] [b]Permadeath:[/b] Unlocked strategies are no longer deleted on permadeath.
[*] [b]Endgame:[/b] Re-playing a completed game starts back at the tavern, with skip privileges and retained strategies.
[*] [b]Map:[/b] Fixed getting stuck with nowhere to go because returning to the Camp is unavailable.
[*] [b]Options menu:[/b] No longer loses focus when navigating with the gamepad shoulder buttons.
[*] [b]Difficulty screen:[/b] Italian text no longer overflows.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix - June 6th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38555693/ac40c5acffb3ea8ee16359ff9265f47e2e30fb56.jpg[/img]This hotfix includes:[list]
[*] Fix for achievements
[/list]
Thank you for playing Card Shark! We're overwhelmed by the reception so far and it makes us very happy that many of you have enjoyed your time with our game. 

We are currently going through [b]every single[/b] comment we've received so that we can address issues as quickly as we can. There are a number of different problems so we'll be prioritizing critical fixes first. 

Card Shark has been a labour of love for the past few years so we want it to be the best game it can be. That's what we're working towards and we appreciate your patience as we try to get there!

tags.bug: Fix for achievements

notes.title: Card Shark Demo - May Update
notes.content:
[h3]Card Shark is 9 days away! [/h3]
Thank you for pre-ordering, playing the Demo and talking about Card Shark! We can't wait for you to cheat your way to the top of 18th century France and dig into the mystery behind the [i]12 Bottles of Milk[/i]. I think you can tell that we've tried to create a unique artistic game. It's really tough to do well as a game like this, so if you want to see more, spread the word about Card Shark.  

[h3]Demo - May Update[/h3]
We have released a [b]small update[/b] to the Card Shark Demo based on player feedback. 
[list][*] Resolved some issues that result in players getting stuck during scenes.[/list] [list][*] Some save files that were stuck should be loadable again.[/list] [list][*] Altered joystick deadzone to improve the experience for players with drifting controllers.[/list] Please continue to report any issues you encounter so that we can investigate them and make the game as good as it can be. 

[h3]Card Shark Memes[/h3]
We post loads of fun memes, developer insights and helpful tips on social media! For example, if you were wondering if there were any sharks in this game, I can promise you that [b]there are no sharks![/b]
[url=https://twitter.com/nerial/status/1527694754464428032][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38555693/de9bc25b22ba24e611cdc6ae0586a177130dcb0e.gif[/img][/url]

[h2]Please give us a follow because it helps spread the word about our game![/h2]

notes.title: Card Shark Demo - Update
notes.content:
[h3]We released an updated version of the Card Shark Demo yesterday! [/h3]

It resolves control issues so if you were having problems with controls before, you can try the Demo again to see if they persist. As always, please let us know if you do encounter any bugs or issues. 

[h3]PAX East[/h3]

We will also be at PAX East today and tomorrow (Friday and Saturday)! Come find our Card Shark Show to receive a [b]special gift[/b].
